Professional case study

Multi-Platform E-commerce & Social Commerce Management

I manage SHOPEVOLUTION, a client’s TikTok Shop, and work on listings across Etsy and eBay. An item that catches someone’s eye in a social feed can raise different questions from one they have deliberately searched for.

View SHOPEVOLUTION on TikTok Shop

Managing a client’s TikTok Shop

SHOPEVOLUTION belongs to my client. As its current TikTok Shop manager, I see the shop from the seller’s side. Its public share card, for example, introduces the shop through product images. A shopper can notice something there before they know its name or what to search for. That first impression is only one part of the decision to buy.

Working on Etsy and eBay listings

Etsy. I write listing titles and tags around the words a shopper might search for. I also work on product images, descriptions and replies to customer questions. For a personalised item, that means making it clear which details the buyer can choose and which are selected by the seller.

eBay. I review listings and day-to-day marketplace issues with the team. I agree priorities with clients, check how their plans have been put into practice and recommend changes where needed.

Questions for future research

My work across these platforms has made me curious about consumer behaviour. When someone discovers a product in a social feed, what helps them judge whether to trust the seller? Does the same information matter when the customer has searched for that item on a marketplace?

A related question for AI in marketing is how shoppers respond when a platform explains why it has recommended a product. I would like to explore whether that explanation changes how the shopping experience feels or what details people check next.
